series.name: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208-240 (status code table)
series.notes: Single-phase GEN24 ('Primo') 3.8-6.0 kW plus the Plus and SC variants. Manual rev. 025 (manual 42,0426,0530). Unit type is on_grid_inverter; with a compatible battery connected (BAT switch position 1) the same unit also provides backup power, but Fronius's own product class and these state codes are grid-tied inverter codes. Codes here are shown on the inverter LED; the text says 'in the event of faults, carry out the individual steps in the Fronius Solar.start app'.

meaning.en: The wired shutdown (WSD) chain is open, so the inverter has shut down. On this model line the operating LED flashes red.
meaning.ur: Wired shutdown (WSD) chain khuli hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Is model line par operating LED laal flash karta hai.

causes.en: A device in the WSD chain has interrupted the signal line - most commonly a surge protection device (SPD) that has tripped.
causes.ur: WSD chain ka koi device signal line tod raha hai - aam tor par koi surge protection device (SPD) jo trigger ho chuka hai.

causes.en: The bypass installed ex works has been removed and no trigger device has been installed instead.
causes.ur: Factory se lagi hui bypass hata di gayi hai aur us ki jagah koi trigger device install nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: The 2-pin signal cable of the surge protection device is interrupted or damaged.
causes.ur: Surge protection device ka 2-pin signal cable kata hua ya damaged hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC and visually check the WSD chain: the SPD indicator (green/red mechanical window) and the 2-pin signal cable back to the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate kar ke WSD chain dekhhein: SPD ka indicator (hara/laal mechanical window) aur inverter tak jaane wala 2-pin signal cable.

solutions.en: If the SPD has tripped, have the inverter repaired by an authorised specialist - Fronius states SPD work may only be carried out by Fronius-trained service personnel.
solutions.ur: Agar SPD trigger hua hai to inverter ki repair authorised specialist se karwayein - Fronius kehta hai SPD ka kaam sirf Fronius-trained service personnel kar sakta hai.

solutions.en: If no emergency stop switch is installed, install the ex-works bypass or a proper trigger device on the WSD connector, and set the WSD switch to position 1 (WSD primary device).
solutions.ur: Agar emergency stop switch installed nahi hai to WSD connector par factory bypass ya proper trigger device lagayein, aur WSD switch ko position 1 (WSD primary device) par set karein.

notes.en: Also published on the Fronius GEN24 support page as '1030: WSD (Wired Shut Down) triggered' (SERIES 2), where it is split into three cases (a/b/c). Same fault, two independent official tables - not merged.
notes.ur: Fronius GEN24 support page par bhi '1030: WSD (Wired Shut Down) triggered' ke naam se publish hua hai (SERIES 2), jahan ise teen cases mein baanta hai (a/b/c). Wahi fault, do alag official tables - merge nahi kiya gaya.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

meaning.en: An arc was identified on the PV system and the maximum number of automatic reconnections within 24 hours has been reached, so the inverter has stopped trying. Operating LED flashes red.
meaning.ur: PV system par arc detect hua aur 24 ghante mein automatic reconnections ki maximum limit poori ho gayi, is liye inverter ne koshish chhorr di. Operating LED laal flash karta hai.

causes.en: A real serial arc on the DC side that re-occurs every time the inverter restarts, e.g. a burnt DC connector or damaged cable insulation.
causes.ur: DC side par asal serial arc jo har restart par dohra rehta hai, jaise jala hua DC connector ya damaged cable insulation.

causes.en: Arcing at a damaged module junction box, bypass diode or a connector that was not fully seated.
causes.ur: Kisi damaged module junction box, bypass diode ya aise connector par arcing jahan connector poora baitha nahi.

solutions.en: Before confirming the code, check the entire affected photovoltaic system for damage - Fronius warns of serious injury and property damage from damaged PV components.
solutions.ur: Code confirm karne se pehle poore affected photovoltaic system ko damage ke liye check karein - Fronius damaged PV components se serious injury aur nuqsan ki warning deta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then inspect and replace burnt, melted or loose DC connectors and any cable with damaged insulation.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate kar ke, jale, pighle ya dheele DC connectors aur damaged insulation wala koi bhi cable inspect karke badal dein.

solutions.en: Only after the arc source is fixed: keep the optical sensor pressed on the inverter for 3 seconds (max. 6 seconds) to acknowledge, or confirm the status in System > Event Log or in the Notifications user menu.
solutions.ur: Sirf arc ka wajaub theek karne ke baad: acknowledge karne ke liye inverter par optical sensor ko 3 second (max 6 second) tak daba kar rakhein, ya System > Event Log ya Notifications user menu mein status confirm karein.

notes.en: Identical fault to 1006 / 1173 in SERIES 1 and SERIES 2; Fronius names it 'ArcContinuousFault' only in this table. Not merged with SERIES 1 / SERIES 2.
notes.ur: SERIES 1 aur SERIES 2 ke 1006 / 1173 se bilkul wahi fault; Fronius ise sirf isi table mein 'ArcContinuousFault' ke naam se likhta hai. SERIES 1 / SERIES 2 ke saath merge nahi kiya gaya.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

meaning.en: An electric arc has been identified on the PV system and the arc signature is being transferred. Fronius states no action is required. Operating LED flashes yellow.
meaning.ur: PV system par electric arc detect hua hai aur arc signature transfer ho rahi hai. Fronius kehta hai koi action zaroori nahi. Operating LED peela flash karta hai.

causes.en: A detected DC arc; the inverter is uploading the arc signature to the cloud to improve arc detection accuracy.
causes.ur: Detect hua DC arc; inverter arc signature cloud par bhej kar arc detection ki accuracy behtar kar raha hai.

causes.en: Arc Logging is switched on, so each detection is recorded and reported.
causes.ur: Arc Logging on hai, is liye har detection record aur report hoti hai.

solutions.en: No action required - this is the documented remedy in the manual.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi - manual mein yehi documented remedy hai.

solutions.en: Still watch for 1173 (ArcContinuousFault) or 1006: if the arc repeats, the inverter will escalate and stop restarting.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi 1173 (ArcContinuousFault) ya 1006 par nazar rakhein: agar arc dohra to inverter escalate hokar restart karna chhorr dega.

solutions.en: If 1191 appears repeatedly with no physical arc found, ask the installer to check Arc Logging and Automatic Signal Recording settings.
solutions.ur: Agar 1191 baar baar aaye aur koi physical arc na mile to installer se Arc Logging aur Automatic Signal Recording settings check karwayein.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions
